description: Get the current authenticated user's profile, including default address, membership, and payment method.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the user profile object.

description: List available retailers, optionally filtered to those delivering to a given zip code.

zip_code.description: Optional zip code to filter retailers by delivery coverage.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of retailer objects.

description: Get the details of a single retailer by its retailer_id.

retailer_id.description: The unique id of the retailer.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the retailer object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Search products with optional filters by retailer, text query, category, and stock, with pagination.

retailer_id.description: Optional retailer id to restrict results to.

query.description: Optional free-text query matched against product name and brand.

category.description: Optional category to filter by (case-insensitive exact match).

in_stock_only.description: If true (default), only in-stock products are returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page (default 25).

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a paginated envelope with total, count, offset, limit, and a results list.

description: Get the details of a single product by its product_id.

product_id.description: The unique id of the product.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the product object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new empty cart for a user at a given retailer.

user_id.description: The id of the user who owns the cart.

retailer_id.description: The id of the retailer the cart is for.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the new cart with computed totals; on failure (retailer not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a cart with its detailed items and computed totals by cart_id.

cart_id.description: The unique id of the cart.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the cart with detailed items and totals; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Add a product to a cart (or increment its quantity if already present).

cart_id.description: The id of the cart to add to.

product_id.description: The id of the product to add.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated cart with totals; on failure (cart/product not found or retailer mismatch), output contains an error message.

description: Set the quantity of a product in a cart; a quantity of zero or less removes the item.

product_id.description: The id of the product to update.

quantity.description: The new quantity; zero or negative removes the item from the cart.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated cart with totals; on failure (cart or item not found), output contains an error message.

description: Check out a cart into a placed order, applying tip and delivery window, if it meets the retailer minimum.

cart_id.description: The id of the cart to check out.

tip.description: Tip amount to add to the order total (default 0.0).

delivery_window_start.description: Optional ISO timestamp for the delivery window start; defaults to two hours from now.

delivery_window_end.description: Optional ISO timestamp for the delivery window end; defaults to one hour after the start.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the newly placed order; on failure (cart not found or minimum not met), output contains an error message.

description: List orders, optionally filtered by user and status, sorted by most recently placed.

user_id.description: Optional user id to filter orders by.

status.description: Optional status to filter orders by (case-insensitive).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an envelope with count and a results list of orders.

description: Get a single order with its line items by order_id.

order_id.description: The unique id of the order.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the order with an items list; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Cancel an order by order_id, unless it is already delivered or cancelled.

order_id.description: The unique id of the order to cancel.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the cancelled order; on failure (not found or non-cancellable status), output contains an error message.
